meta.source: Venom ecosystem, from scratch; seeded from metalelf0/black-metal-theme-neovim (venom palette) with Ryoku and Hermes Agent as references

color.note: Black, bone and blood. trve is the default (dark, pure-black ground, like black-metal's trve=true). bone is the light theme, tuned separately, not inverted. One edition signal per product.

tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page and terminal background. The default ground for everything.

tokens.name: crypt
tokens.usage: Raised ground: pane bodies, code blocks, cards on void.

tokens.name: grave
tokens.usage: Alternate ground from the black-metal 'Venom' alt_bg: status bars, selected rows, inactive tabs.

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: Selection and hover fill. Text on it stays bone.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines and inactive pane borders (decorative, not a control edge).

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, ghost buttons. Meets 3:1 on void, crypt and grave.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Primary text, on void, crypt, grave and ash.

tokens.name: bone-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, pane content that is not focused. On void, crypt, grave.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: labels, timestamps, section numbers. On void, crypt, grave.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and syntax comments only. Below 4.5:1 by design (black-metal comment colour); never for content.

tokens.name: blood
tokens.usage: The Venom signal. Brand accent and the venom (orchestrator) edition colour. Text on void, crypt, grave.

tokens.name: on-blood
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a blood fill.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: venomx edition signal (Bathory). Focused pane border, active window in the venomx status bar. Text on void, crypt, grave.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Text on an ember fill.

tokens.name: lichen
tokens.usage: venom-os edition signal (Burzum). Also the success status. Text on void, crypt, grave.

tokens.name: on-lichen
tokens.usage: Text on a lichen fill.

tokens.name: verdigris
tokens.usage: Secondary highlight from black-metal 'alt': links in docs, matched search terms. Text on void and crypt.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Warning status and 'waiting for approval' agent state (Mayhem). Text on void, crypt, grave.

tokens.name: frost
tokens.usage: Info status and 'agent running' state (Immortal). Text on void, crypt, grave.

tokens.name: signal-venom
tokens.usage: Edition signal for venom, the orchestrator.

tokens.name: signal-venomx
tokens.usage: Edition signal for venomx, the multiplexer.

tokens.name: signal-venom-os
tokens.usage: Edition signal for venom-os, the bundle.

tokens.name: logo-ink
tokens.usage: The one neutral ink of the line marks and wordmark, on void, crypt and grave. Holds 3:1 or better on all three in both themes.

tokens.name: logo-venom
tokens.usage: Muted logo colour for Venom and venom: the drop in the line mark and the whole icon. Logos only; UI keeps signal-venom. 3:1 or better on void, crypt and grave.

tokens.name: logo-venomx
tokens.usage: Muted logo colour for venomx: the drop in the line mark and the whole icon. Logos only; UI keeps signal-venomx. 3:1 or better on void, crypt and grave.

tokens.name: logo-venom-os
tokens.usage: Muted logo colour for venom-os: the drop in the line mark and the whole icon. Logos only; UI keeps signal-venom-os. 3:1 or better on void, crypt and grave.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Errors, denied approvals, crashed agents. Always paired with the ✕ glyph.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Warnings and pending approvals. Always paired with the ▲ glyph.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Success, healthy daemon, finished turn. Always paired with the ● glyph.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Info and running agents. Always paired with the ◆ glyph.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px. bone on void is 18:1.

tokens.name: ansi-0
tokens.usage: ANSI black.

tokens.name: ansi-1
tokens.usage: ANSI red: errors, deletions in diffs.

tokens.name: ansi-2
tokens.usage: ANSI green: additions in diffs, success.

tokens.name: ansi-3
tokens.usage: ANSI yellow: warnings.

tokens.name: ansi-4
tokens.usage: ANSI blue.

tokens.name: ansi-5
tokens.usage: ANSI magenta (Emperor).

tokens.name: ansi-6
tokens.usage: ANSI cyan (verdigris).

tokens.name: ansi-7
tokens.usage: ANSI white.

tokens.name: ansi-8
tokens.usage: ANSI bright black: comments, dim output.

tokens.name: ansi-9
tokens.usage: ANSI bright red.

tokens.name: ansi-10
tokens.usage: ANSI bright green.

tokens.name: ansi-11
tokens.usage: ANSI bright yellow (Bathory).

tokens.name: ansi-12
tokens.usage: ANSI bright blue.

tokens.name: ansi-13
tokens.usage: ANSI bright magenta.

tokens.name: ansi-14
tokens.usage: ANSI bright cyan.

tokens.name: ansi-15
tokens.usage: ANSI bright white.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Product names in docs headers and fallback hero names where the line lettering can't be drawn. Uppercase. One per page.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Stat figures and one pull line per page, uppercase.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Headings inside docs and cards. Sentence case.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page and section titles, upright, sentence case, ending in a full stop. Scales down to 40px on small screens. Never for UI.

styles.name: tagline
styles.sample: orchestrate the swarm, keep the knife
styles.usage: One italic line under a hero name. Never for UI.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text everywhere: docs, UI, TUI.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, install commands, pane content.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Numbered section labels, pane titles, status bar segments. Uppercase.

spacing.note: A 4px step; in a TUI one step = one cell, so think in cells (1 cell ≈ 8px wide at 13px mono).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, badge padding, one terminal cell.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Pane padding, button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on mobile, card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between components.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between numbered sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

radius.note: Square by default. The fang cut (a 45° chamfer) replaces rounding wherever a corner wants character.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default for panes, cards, blocks, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Inputs and badges, so they don't look like broken pixels.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: The rare floating surface: tooltips, the command palette.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Rules and inactive pane borders.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focused pane border and the focus ring.
